# PCMag
> PCMag is a technology publication covering product reviews, buying advice, software, security, business tech, and consumer electronics.

PCMag publishes hands-on reviews, tested recommendations, how-to articles, news, and analysis across computing, mobile, networking, privacy, streaming, and emerging technology. Its strongest resources are product review hubs, “Best” picks, category indexes, and practical guides for consumers and small businesses.

## Reviews & Product Testing
- [Reviews](https://www.pcmag.com/reviews): Main reviews hub for hardware, software, services, and consumer technology products.
- [Laptops](https://www.pcmag.com/categories/laptops): Laptop reviews, rankings, and category coverage for ultraportables, gaming, and business systems.
- [Desktop PCs](https://www.pcmag.com/categories/desktop-pcs): Desktop computer reviews including towers, all-in-ones, mini PCs, and workstations.
- [Mobile Phones](https://www.pcmag.com/categories/mobile-phones): Smartphone reviews and comparisons across iPhone, Android, budget, and flagship devices.
- [Tablets](https://www.pcmag.com/categories/tablets): Tablet reviews and recommendations for iPad, Android, Amazon Fire, and productivity use.
- [Printers](https://www.pcmag.com/categories/printers): Printer reviews for home, office, photo, laser, and all-in-one models.
- [Monitors](https://www.pcmag.com/categories/monitors): Monitor reviews covering gaming, productivity, ultrawide, portable, and professional displays.
- [TVs](https://www.pcmag.com/categories/tvs): Television reviews with testing for picture quality, gaming features, and smart TV platforms.

## Buying Guides & Best Picks
- [Picks](https://www.pcmag.com/picks): Central hub for PCMag’s tested recommendations and “best of” buying guides.
- [The Best Laptops](https://www.pcmag.com/picks/the-best-laptops): Top laptop recommendations across budget, premium, business, and gaming categories.
- [The Best Desktop Computers](https://www.pcmag.com/picks/the-best-desktop-computers): Recommended desktop PCs for home, office, creative work, and gaming.
- [The Best Phones](https://www.pcmag.com/picks/the-best-phones): Best smartphone picks for iPhone, Android, camera, battery, and value shoppers.
- [The Best Tablets](https://www.pcmag.com/picks/the-best-tablets): Recommended tablets for entertainment, note-taking, work, and family use.
- [The Best VPN Services](https://www.pcmag.com/picks/the-best-vpn-services): Tested VPN recommendations for privacy, streaming, travel, and multi-device protection.
- [The Best Antivirus Protection](https://www.pcmag.com/picks/the-best-antivirus-protection): Top antivirus software picks for malware defense, privacy, and device security.
- [The Best Wi-Fi Routers](https://www.pcmag.com/picks/the-best-wireless-routers): Router recommendations for apartments, large homes, gaming, and Wi-Fi performance.

## Computing
- [Computers](https://www.pcmag.com/categories/computers): Broad computing coverage spanning laptops, desktops, components, and peripherals.
- [Computer Monitors](https://www.pcmag.com/categories/monitors): Display coverage for office, gaming, creator, and portable monitor buyers.
- [Keyboards](https://www.pcmag.com/categories/keyboards): Keyboard reviews for mechanical, wireless, ergonomic, and gaming models.
- [Mice](https://www.pcmag.com/categories/mice): Mouse reviews covering productivity, travel, ergonomic, and gaming options.
- [Graphics Cards](https://www.pcmag.com/categories/graphics-cards): GPU reviews and analysis for gaming, creators, and PC upgrades.
- [Processors](https://www.pcmag.com/categories/processors): CPU coverage for desktop and laptop performance, value, and platform comparisons.
- [Storage Devices](https://www.pcmag.com/categories/storage-devices): SSD, external drive, NAS, and backup hardware reviews.
- [Printers & Scanners](https://www.pcmag.com/categories/printers): Printing hardware coverage for home offices, businesses, and photo workflows.

## Mobile
- [Mobile Phones](https://www.pcmag.com/categories/mobile-phones): Reviews, news, and buying advice for smartphones and mobile ecosystems.
- [Smartwatches](https://www.pcmag.com/categories/smartwatches): Smartwatch reviews for fitness, notifications, battery life, and platform compatibility.
- [Fitness Trackers](https://www.pcmag.com/categories/fitness-trackers): Wearable reviews focused on health tracking, workouts, and everyday activity monitoring.
- [Headphones](https://www.pcmag.com/categories/headphones): Earbuds and headphones coverage for mobile listening, calls, and travel.
- [Mobile Apps](https://www.pcmag.com/categories/mobile-apps): App recommendations and reviews for productivity, communication, and entertainment.
- [Carriers](https://www.pcmag.com/categories/mobile-carriers): Coverage of wireless carriers, plans, network performance, and mobile service comparisons.

## Security & Privacy
- [SecurityWatch](https://www.pcmag.com/securitywatch): PCMag’s security and privacy reporting, analysis, and practical protection advice.
- [Security](https://www.pcmag.com/categories/security): Security software and services coverage including antivirus, VPNs, and identity tools.
- [VPN](https://www.pcmag.com/categories/vpn): VPN reviews and explainers for privacy, streaming access, and secure browsing.
- [Antivirus](https://www.pcmag.com/categories/antivirus): Antivirus product reviews, malware protection comparisons, and endpoint security advice.
- [Password Managers](https://www.pcmag.com/categories/password-managers): Password manager reviews for secure logins, sharing, and cross-device syncing.
- [Identity Theft Protection](https://www.pcmag.com/categories/identity-theft-protection): Services and tools for monitoring fraud, breaches, and identity misuse.
- [Parental Control](https://www.pcmag.com/categories/parental-control): Reviews of parental control apps and services for family device management.
- [Privacy Tools](https://www.pcmag.com/categories/privacy): Coverage of privacy-focused software, browsers, and online protection tools.

## Networking, Internet & Smart Home
- [Networking](https://www.pcmag.com/categories/networking): Home and office networking coverage for routers, mesh, broadband, and Wi-Fi.
- [Routers](https://www.pcmag.com/categories/routers): Router reviews for speed, coverage, gaming, and advanced networking features.
- [Mesh Systems](https://www.pcmag.com/categories/mesh-networking-systems): Mesh Wi-Fi system reviews for whole-home coverage and easier setup.
- [Modems](https://www.pcmag.com/categories/modems): Cable modem reviews and buying advice for broadband compatibility and performance.
- [NAS Devices](https://www.pcmag.com/categories/nas): Network-attached storage reviews for backup, media serving, and small business use.
- [Smart Home](https://www.pcmag.com/categories/smart-home): Smart home device reviews for security, lighting, automation, and connected living.
- [Home Security Cameras](https://www.pcmag.com/categories/home-security-cameras): Camera reviews for indoor, outdoor, wired, and battery-powered monitoring.
- [Video Doorbells](https://www.pcmag.com/categories/video-doorbells): Doorbell camera reviews focused on alerts, video quality, and subscriptions.

## Software & Services
- [Software](https://www.pcmag.com/categories/software): Reviews and recommendations for productivity, creativity, utility, and business software.
- [Business](https://www.pcmag.com/categories/business): Business software and services coverage for collaboration, CRM, accounting, and operations.
- [Web Hosting](https://www.pcmag.com/categories/web-hosting): Hosting service reviews for shared, VPS, WordPress, and business websites.
- [Email Marketing](https://www.pcmag.com/categories/email-marketing): Reviews of email marketing platforms for campaigns, automation, and analytics.
- [Accounting](https://www.pcmag.com/categories/accounting): Accounting software reviews for freelancers, SMBs, and financial management.
- [Project Management](https://www.pcmag.com/categories/project-management): Project management tool reviews for teams, workflows, and collaboration.
- [Online Learning](https://www.pcmag.com/categories/online-learning): Reviews of online course platforms and digital education services.
- [Streaming Services](https://www.pcmag.com/categories/video-streaming-services): Streaming platform reviews for movies, TV, sports, and live channels.

## How-To, Explainers & Advice
- [How-To](https://www.pcmag.com/how-to): Practical tutorials and troubleshooting guides for devices, apps, and online services.
- [Tips & Tricks](https://www.pcmag.com/how-to): Instructional articles for setup, optimization, privacy, and everyday tech tasks.
- [Explainers](https://www.pcmag.com/explainers): Background articles clarifying technologies, standards, and product categories.
- [Best Products](https://www.pcmag.com/picks): Curated recommendations based on PCMag testing and editorial evaluation.
- [Deals](https://www.pcmag.com/deals): Tech deals coverage highlighting discounts on hardware, software, and subscriptions.
- [Newsletters](https://www.pcmag.com/newsletters): Email newsletter signup hub for reviews, security, deals, and tech news.

## News, Features & Opinion
- [News](https://www.pcmag.com/news): Technology news coverage spanning devices, platforms, policy, and industry developments.
- [Features](https://www.pcmag.com/features): Longer-form reporting, analysis, comparisons, and trend pieces across tech topics.
- [Opinion](https://www.pcmag.com/opinions): Commentary and perspective on technology products, companies, and digital culture.
- [SecurityWatch](https://www.pcmag.com/securitywatch): Dedicated security reporting on threats, breaches, scams, and privacy developments.
- [Business Choice](https://www.pcmag.com/business-choice): Survey-based rankings and satisfaction reports for business technology products and services.
- [Fastest ISPs](https://www.pcmag.com/fastest-isps): Annual broadband performance reporting and regional ISP speed comparisons.

## Video, Podcasts & Special Coverage
- [Videos](https://www.pcmag.com/videos): Video reviews, explainers, product demos, and event coverage from PCMag editors.
- [Podcasts](https://www.pcmag.com/podcasts): Audio programming featuring tech discussion, interviews, and editorial analysis.
- [Best Products of the Year](https://www.pcmag.com/picks/the-best-tech-products): Annual roundup of standout products across major technology categories.
- [Editors' Choice](https://www.pcmag.com/editors-choice): Award-winning products recognized for exceptional performance and value.
- [Product Finder](https://www.pcmag.com/product-finder): Guided discovery tool for narrowing products by category and priorities.
- [Deals Hub](https://www.pcmag.com/deals): Ongoing roundup of notable discounts on tested and popular tech products.
